evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <fresh scratch dir>

scenario_name_decoding.claim: the '_60' suffix is Syndra's Splinters-of-Wrath stack count (the module's 0-120 'splinters' option), not level (cap 20), not sphere count (R caps at 3+4=7)
scenario_name_decoding.support: data/champion-audit/batch-6.json gap_summary: 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff'; 60 is exactly one of Syndra's five wiki thresholds (40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120)
scenario_name_decoding.note: the scenario definition itself lives outside the permitted evidence tree (nothing in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md mentions 'syndra_custom_order', 'custom_order' or 'manual_target'), so the exact custom cast list could not be read; the computation below is therefore threshold-based and is robust to any splinters >= 60

step_1_thresholds_active_at_60_splinters.Q (40): ACTIVE - 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' 60 >= 40, so the second Dark Sphere charge (the module's synthetic Q2 slot, per data/champion-audit/batch-6.json module_slots.modeled = [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R]) exists and is castable in the rotation.
step_1_thresholds_active_at_60_splinters.W (60): ACTIVE - 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.' 60 >= 60 (threshold met exactly).
step_1_thresholds_active_at_60_splinters.E (80): INACTIVE - 'Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak to have an increased scatter angle and slow...' 60 < 80, and the bonus is utility only (no damage) in any case.

step_2_W_overtakes_E_in_damage_at_exactl.consistency_check: the wiki's 'Total Mixed Damage' row is exactly 1.12x the base row (70*1.12=78.4, 100*1.12=112, 130*1.12=145.6, 160*1.12=179.2, 190*1.12=212.8), confirming the '12% bonus true damage' reading and that the parsed table is self-consistent
step_2_W_overtakes_E_in_damage_at_exactl.algebra: without the bonus, W - E = (190 + 0.65*AP) - (200 + 0.60*AP) = 0.05*AP - 10, so E leads for AP < 200. With the 60-splinter bonus, W - E = (212.8 + 0.766*AP + 0.0114*AP^2/100) - (200 + 0.60*AP) = 12.8 + 0.166*AP + 0.0114*AP^2/100 > 0 for every AP >= 0, at every equal rank (rank 1: 78.4 + 0.742*AP vs 60 + 0.60*AP, also strictly W). The W/E ordering therefore flips at exactly the 60-Splinter threshold this scenario pins.
step_2_W_overtakes_E_in_damage_at_exactl.true_damage_note: docs/math-foundations.md and CLAUDE.md domain knowledge: true damage ignores all resistances, so the 12% (+2%/100 AP) true component is not shrunk by the target's MR while E's whole packet is multiplied by m(R)=100/(100+MR). Against any MR > 0 the post-mitigation gap is strictly larger than the raw gap above, so the ordering conclusion only strengthens.

independent_computation.step_3_ordering_argument: Every mechanism that can place an ability at rotation index 2 points to W at splinters=60, and none points to E: (a) SLOT-COUNT: with the 40-splinter charge active the castable sequence gains the Q2 slot, so the head of the rotation is Q, Q2, W, ... and index 2 (0-based) is W, where a rotation that ignored the second charge would read Q, W, E, ... and put E at index 2 - exactly the old value; (b) DAMAGE PRIORITY: if slots are ordered by damage, step 2 shows W strictly outdamages E at 60 splinters at every rank and every AP, so W precedes E; (c) COOLDOWN AVAILABILITY: W's cooldown [12, 11, 10, 9, 8] is shorter than E's flat [15, 15, 15, 15, 15] at every rank, so on the shared-timeline renewal schedule (docs/math-foundations.md 1.1, '_schedule_shared_casts' / '_compute_ability_rotation': casts on one shared timeline, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed) W always recurs before E. Ability haste is a common scale factor (cd' = cd*100/(100+AH)) and cannot reverse that inequality.
independent_computation.conclusion: E at fights/manual_target/rotation/order[2] requires either dropping the 40-splinter second Dark Sphere charge or ignoring the 60-splinter Force of Will enhancement - both wiki-sourced effects that are active at exactly splinters = 60. W is the correct value.

Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak to have an increased scatter angle and slow enemies hit by 70% ...
modeled = [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R] ... 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff'
E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage)

sources_quoted.path: section 1.1 / verdict table row 'Ability rotation casts'
sources_quoted.text: Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (_schedule_shared_casts).
cd' = cd*100/(100+AH); casts/unit time affine in AH

caveats: The scenario definition (its custom cast list, ranks, items, AP and fight mode) is not reachable from the permitted evidence tree; the argument is therefore threshold- and inequality-based rather than a re-run of the scenario. It holds for any splinters >= 60 and any AP >= 0 at equal ability ranks.

If '_60' were instead ability haste rather than Splinters, the cooldown argument (c) still orders W before E at every rank, since haste scales both cooldowns by the same factor 100/(100+AH); no reading of '60' found in the cached data produces E at this slot.
